summary: Added GPU utilization panel to the fleet dashboard: (1) three new query functions in queries.py — get_gpu_utilization (per-node active GPU tasks vs gpu_capacity), get_gpu_queue_depth (pending GPU tasks count), get_oom_count (oom_killed tasks in last 24h); (2) gpu_panel.html fragment template with per-node percentage gauges, GPU queue depth counter, and OOM event counter; (3) Resource column (CPU/GPU badge) added to active_tasks.html; (4) /fragments/gpu-panel route added to fragments.py; (5) GPU panel card added to index.html above the utilization chart; (6) CSS added for gauge bars, GPU panel layout, and resource class badges.
